say:1:1035130001:0.text: Ah, sorry! I didn't see you there.

say:2:1035130002:0.text: I'm with the Evergreen Conservatory, part of an expedition team meant to inspect a set of ruins.

say:6:1035130005:1.text: I specialize in golem taxonomy. My research indicates that they can be roughly classified according to three sizes: small, medium, and large.

say:7:1035130006:1.text: Large golems have both strength and aggression proportional to their size.
say:7:1035130006:1.source_cn: 大型魔偶具有与其体型相匹配的力量与攻击性。
say:7:1035130006:1.male: Large golems have both strength and aggression proportional to their size.
say:7:1035130006:1.female: Large golems have both strength and aggression proportional to their size.

say:8:1035130007:1.text: Most medium golems are equipped with mechanisms that allow them to launch projectiles, such as cleaning solutions!
say:8:1035130007:1.source_cn: 中型魔偶多有带有某种发射装置，可以射出比如……清洁泡泡！
say:8:1035130007:1.male: Most medium golems are equipped with mechanisms that allow them to launch projectiles, such as cleaning solutions!

say:9:1035130008:1.text: My guess is that they were once created as tools of some sort, but it's quite concerning that they're now so aggressive.

say:11:1035130009:1.text: Small golems are similar to birds in appearance and pose relatively little threat.
